daily.today_energy: Your vibe is giving thoughtful and intentional today. The cosmos is nudging you to trust your gut more—that little voice knows something your overthinking brain hasn't caught up to yet.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled or solo, there's a sweetness in the air around vulnerability. Someone might surprise you with authenticity today, or you might surprise yourself by letting walls down a bit.
daily.career: Your ideas are hitting different right now. This is a solid day to speak up in meetings or share that project you've been sitting on. Your perspective has real value—don't dim it.
daily.health: Your energy feels more balanced when you're moving intentionally rather than rushing. A walk, stretch, or even just sitting somewhere you feel good will do wonders for your mental space.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to lean into authenticity, Libra. Venus is vibing with your sector of self-expression, so trust those instincts that feel a little unconventional. You're in a season of recalibration—let go of what no longer serves your growth.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, the cosmos is asking you to get real about what you actually want, not what sounds good on paper. If you're dating, someone's energy might surprise you this week. Stay open but grounded in your values.
weekly.career: Your professional momentum builds through honest communication and creative problem-solving. This isn't the week to play small—your unique perspective is literally your superpower right now. Trust yourself to bring something different to the table.
weekly.health: Your mind-body connection is especially strong this week. Whatever movement or wellness practice has been calling to you, now's the moment to try it. You're naturally more attuned to what your body actually needs versus what you think you should do.
